content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high-rate CrashLoopBackOffs for pods matching label app=inference-runtime in prod-gpu-us-west. Root cause suspected: segfault in native fused kernel (recent quantized-kernel rollout). Alert window: 09:07:14 UTC.
Sofia Morales: taking pager — joining voice.
Raj Patel: oncall handoff accepted. tagging runtime eng. @Alice Chen @Kenji Tanaka can you join?
Alice Chen: on it. initial triage: saw same stack on two different nodes (gpu-7, gpu-9). crash happens ~10s after container start.
Kenji Tanaka: grabbing logs now.
Kenji Tanaka: `kubectl -n prod logs inference-runtime-5f4d7b8d4-2k6r -c runtime` shows immediate SIGSEGV. snippet:```
[2026-03-15T09:06:52.123Z] runtime: segfault at 0x0 ip 0x7f9c1a2b3e4f sp 0x7fffa9c3bcd0 error 4
#0 0x7f9c1a2b3e4f in fused_attention_kernel+0x2f
#1 0x7f9c1a2b6a70 in run_inference_loop+0x1b0
#2 0x55a12345 in main+0x3d
```
Sofia Morales: can we get `dmesg`/kernel info and coredump?
Kenji Tanaka: dmesg shows NVRM: Xid 86 GPU fault (faulted channel). grabbing coredump with gcore.
Alice Chen: I'm going to patch the deployment to disable fused kernel as a mitigation: set env REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1 for inference-runtime. That should fall back to safe path.
Raj Patel: do it. Also scale up fallback replica set (cpu-fallback) so we avoid customer errors.
Alice Chen: running: `kubectl -n prod set env deployment/inference-runtime REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1` -> patch applied. rolling restart.
deploy-bot: Rolling restart started for deployment/inference-runtime (image: redwood/runtime:1.28.0).
Kenji Tanaka: restarting pods now. new pods come up but some still crash; patched pods use fallback path but old image process still tries fused kernel for a few seconds during init — we should drain the two affected nodes.
Sofia Morales: I'll cordon/drain gpu-7 and gpu-9 to force scheduling away.
Sofia Morales: `kubectl cordon gpu-7 && kubectl drain gpu-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`
Kenji Tanaka: drain completed. new pods scheduled on gpu-2/gpu-4. crashloop rate drops.
support-bot: Customer impact: ~12% of active inference requests returned 5xx during incident window, primarily 09:06–09:11 UTC. Affected customers: customer-a (low-volume), customer-b (one endpoint). CS notified.
Raj Patel: note — we need logs from the old crash loops for a root cause ticket. Alice, can you upload the gcore and logs to s3? Use s3://redwood-incident-dumps/2178901234/
Alice Chen: uploading now: `aws s3 cp /tmp/core.inference-runtime.1234 s3://redwood-incident-dumps/2178901234/` -> done. also uploaded `kubectl-describe` and dmesg.
Kenji Tanaka: capturing run of `LD_PRELOAD` and environment differences between good and bad pods. Initial suspicion: a kernel-level optimization in fused kernel triggers an out-of-bounds read when sequence length aligns with a quantized packing boundary.
Sofia Morales: for immediate mitigation we've: 1) disabled fused kernel via env var 2) cordoned and drained affected nodes 3) scaled up CPU-backend replicas 4) restarted deployments. Error rate has fallen to ~0.5% now.
Raj Patel: good. put incident into mitigation state, begin postmortem. assign owners: runtime-engine (Alice), quantization-research (Kenji), SRE (Sofia).
Alice Chen: filing Jira: INF-6231 with crash logs, s3 links, and a minimal reproducer. linking to this thread.
Alice Chen: short-term rollback option: revert the quantized-fused-kernel artifact (release 1.28.0 -> 1.27.9) if mitigation fails. prefer to debug first since rollback affects perf.
Kenji Tanaka: i've got a local reproducer on a dev box with synthetic inputs causing the same segfault. will try to bisect.
Sofia Morales: communications: @support-bot please post interim customer note: "We observed elevated errors earlier; mitigation applied; we are investigating root cause and will follow up."
support-bot: Posted to #support-notifications.
Raj Patel: checklist before close: confirm rollback not needed, collect core+stacktrace, update runbook with 'disable fused kernel env var' step, schedule postmortem, notify affected customers with timeline.
Sofia Morales: scheduling 1h postmortem at 10:30 UTC. invite runtime-eng, quantization, SRE, CS.
Alice Chen: follow-ups: add feature flag for fused kernel that can opt out per-model, add metrics for kernel fallback counts, increase canary ramp checks.
Kenji Tanaka: next steps for root cause analysis: bisect fused kernel changeset between tags v1.27.9..v1.28.0, add ASAN build replicant, and create unit tests for boundary packing.
Sofia Morales: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. I'll leave cordon until kernel team confirms safe.
Raj Patel: thanks team. thumbs up for the quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
